name: Tan AK-74
teaser: Adds a tan AK-74 with parts... of questionable taste
description_html:
Description

Content

- Tan AK-74

- Tan AK-74 gas block (6P20 Sb.1-2)

- Tan AK polymer grip (6P1 Sb.8)
- Tan AK-74M Receiver (6P34 0-1)
- Tan AK-74M Receiver (6P34 0-1) Waifu Sticker Edition

- Tan 5.45 Hexagon Suppressor

- Tan PT-1 Stock
- Tan PT-1 stock adapter

- Tan RS47 handguard
- USB of Sauce

Obtaining

Almost all weapon items can be bought off Mechanic 2 by purchasing the gun preset

The special receiver can be acquired through a crafting tree (or bought on flea)

Crafting

USB of Sauce:

crafted with a Secure Flash Drive @ Intel 2

Tan AK-74M Receiver (6P34 0-1) Waifu Sticker Edition:

crafted with USB of Sauce, Tan AK-74M Receiver (6P34 0-1), and paper @ Workbench 1
